$sources: NBR 6123:1988 Sections 4-6: Vk = V0 S1 S2 S3 (5.1), S1 topography (5.2), S2 = b Fr (z/10)^p (5.3, Table 21 parameters), S3 statistical factor (5.4, Table 3), q = 0.613 Vk² (4.2)
source: NBR 6123:1988: the characteristic speed Vk = V0 S1 S2 S3 and q = 0.613 Vk² [N/m²] by the generic speedFactors method (k1 = S3 from the occupancy's windImportance, k2 = S2 of the terrain category for class B buildings (20-50 m), k3 = S1 the topographic factor, 1.0 on flat ground); storey forces by the wall coefficients +0.8 windward and the base pack's leeward values (SAEngine practice for NBR 6123's drag coefficient Ca of Figure 4: see VERIFY.md B13). The cladding, open structures, signs and the dynamic response of NBR 6123 Section 9 are not covered.

I.description: Category I: smooth surfaces of large extent (sea, lakes, rivers, swamps without vegetation)

II.description: Category II: open level terrain with few isolated obstacles (fields, farmland, airports), obstacles up to 1 m

III.description: Category III: level or undulating terrain with obstacles (hedges, walls, scattered low buildings), obstacles about 3 m

IV.description: Category IV: many closely spaced obstacles (woodland, towns, industrial areas, suburbs), obstacles about 10 m

V.description: Category V: many large, high, closely spaced obstacles (large city centres, forests with tall trees), obstacles 25 m and more

sources.speedFactors.heightFactors: NBR 6123 5.3: S2 = b Fr (z/10)^p, class B (largest dimension 20-50 m): b / p = I 1.10 / 0.065, II 1.00 / 0.09, III 0.94 / 0.105, IV 0.86 / 0.125, V 0.74 / 0.16, Fr 0.98 (Table 21 as SAEngine recalls it; constant above the gradient height zg 250, 300, 350, 420, 500 m); classes A and C (Fr 1.00, 0.95, other p) not set: VERIFY.md B11
sources.speedFactors.riskCoefficients: No rows: k1 = the occupancy's windImportance = S3 (NBR 6123 Table 3)
sources.topographic: NBR 6123 5.2: S1 = 1.0 on flat or gently undulating ground (enter 0.9 for deep valleys, the hill factor for slopes, in Project Settings > Wind)
sources.gust: NBR 6123: V0 is a 3-second gust and S2 the gust profile; the coefficients include the gusts (1.0)
sources.cpWindward: SAEngine practice: the net drag of a closed rectangular building (NBR 6123 Figure 4, Ca about 1.1-1.4) as +0.8 windward and the leeward coefficient by L/B (VERIFY.md B13)
